title: Transient Artifact
description: Base schema for Archeia transient artifacts — tasks, plans, running experiments, and Instance-declared proposals that flow through lifecycle states and are pruned after a bounded retention window.

id.description: Stable identifier for this artifact across its lifecycle.

author.description: Who (human or agent) created the artifact.

status.description: Instance-declared status value. Every status value must map to exactly one temporal category (future, present, past) via the Instance manifest lifecycles mapping.

started.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the artifact transitioned from a future-mapped status to a present-mapped status.

terminal_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the artifact reached a past-mapped status. The field name in the actual artifact is Instance-declared (e.g., 'completed', 'cancelled_at', 'concluded', 'discarded_at') but the semantic role is this: it starts the retention clock.

archeia.temporal_derivation: status -> temporal via Instance manifest lifecycles
